import os,re
def load():

    # need marker color: color of cells not part of the contiguous block. Heuristic: block is rectangular solid region; markers isolated.
    # generalize: find all non-bg cells; block = maximal rectangle... use demo knowledge: block cells form rectangle, markers single.
    # Simpler: non-bg cells; group; block = largest group by connected component? Use component sizes.
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    import sys
    sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)
    def nb(i,j):
        for a,b in ((i+1,j),(i-1,j),(i,j+1),(i,j-1)):
            if 0<=a<H and 0<=b<W: yield a,b
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and (i,j) not in seen:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j)); comp=[]
                while st:

                        if g[a2][b2]!=bg and (a2,b2) not in seen:
                            seen.add((a2,b2)); st.append((a2,b2))
                comps.append(comp)
    comps.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    block=comps[0]
    mkcolor=None
    iset=set(block)
    for comp in comps[1:]:
        pass
    # block bounding box
    is_=[a for a,b in block]; js_=[b for a,b in block]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(is_),max(is_),min(js_),max(js_)
    assert (r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)==len(block)
    B=[[g[i][j] for j in range(c0,c1+1)] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    bh,bw=len(B),len(B[0])
    mkcolor=next(v for i,j in comps[1:] for v in [g[i][j]])
    mks=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==mkcolor]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    ci,cj=r0+(bh-1)//2 - r0, c0+(bw-1)//2 - c0  # center indices within B

    return out
